name: guestbook
title: Guestbook
description: A list of signed messages with a composer, like the Lantern guestbook. Entries show initials, a name, relative time and the message.
notes: GuestbookEntry takes time as a Date, timestamp or ISO string and shows it as relative time that refreshes every minute. Any other string is shown as written.
GuestbookComposer keeps its own draft, counts characters against maxLength (280 by default) and calls onSign with the trimmed message. Ctrl or Cmd plus Enter also signs.
